extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 8 m street light: conical steel pole 190 mm at the base to 76 mm at the top (7.3 m), 60.3 mm curved outreach arm 1.45 m, LED luminaire 720 x 300 x 65 mm, light point height ~8.0 m, 400 x 400 mm anchor plate with 4 x M30
extras.notes: LED panel is a separate object (street-light_led_panel) with an emissive texture for night scenes. Service door with triangular-key lock on the back of the pole foot. No text or logos.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
